en.p: There are two distinct points $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{B}$ on the curve $y=\log_{2}x$. Let $\mathrm{P}$ be the foot of the perpendicular from point $\mathrm{A}$ to the line $y=x$, and let $\mathrm{Q}$ be the reflection of point $\mathrm{B}$ across the line $y=x$. The four points $\mathrm{A}$, $\mathrm{B}$, $\mathrm{P}$, $\mathrm{Q}$ satisfy the following conditions.
When the area of quadrilateral $\mathrm{APQB}$ is $\dfrac{q}{p}$, find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
